newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Securities revises up 1997 net.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Securities revises up 1997 net.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Lippo Securities said on Monday it had revised up its 1997 net profit forecast to 121.6 billion rupiah from its previous 95.7 billion rupiah.
The brokerage firm, which posted a net profit of 45.7 billion rupiah in 1996, last May revised its initial net forecast of 87.0 billion rupiah up to 95.7 billion rupiah.

"Lippo Securities has revised up its 1997 earnings forecast by 40 percent from the originally forecast figure of 87 billion rupiah to 121.6 billion," the company said in its statement released on Monday.

"This is the company's third earnings revision this year as major revenue drivers including commission income, corporate finance fees, proprietary trading and net interest income are all showing better than anticipated results," it said.

The company made the announcement after a shareholders meeting on Friday at which it also said it would increase its dividend payment by 25 percent with each shareholder as of July 23 receiving a dividend of 25 rupiah per share payable on August 21.
It said Lippo Securities shareholders also approved the company's plan ot raise 783 billion rupiah of fresh capital capital via a twelve for five rights issue.
